en.headline: Golden Week day four passes 616,000 crossings by 4pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department recorded about 337,500 arrivals and 278,000 departures by 4pm on Sunday, with Lok Ma Chau Spur Line the busiest inbound point.
body: Hong Kong recorded more than 616,200 boundary crossings by 4pm on Sunday, the fourth day of the mainland National Day Golden Week, the Immigration Department said.

Arrivals accounted for about 337,500 of the total and departures for about 278,000, according to figures reported by RTHK. Among those arriving, more than 173,000 were mainland visitors and more than 146,000 were Hong Kong residents. Lok Ma Chau Spur Line was the busiest control point for arrivals, followed by Lo Wu.
Departures were led by Hong Kong residents, at more than 194,000. People leaving the city mainly used the airport and Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

Earlier on Sunday the department had logged more than 184,700 crossings by 10am. Financial Secretary Paul Chan has said more than 732,000 mainland visitor trips were recorded in the first three days of the holiday, about 8.4 per cent more than a year earlier, and that the full Golden Week was expected to bring about 1.29 million mainland visitors.

zh.headline: 黃金周第四日截至下午四時逾61萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，星期日下午四時前錄得約33萬7500人次入境、約27萬8000人次出境，落馬洲支線是入境最繁忙管制站。
body: 內地國慶黃金周第四日，入境處表示，截至星期日下午四時，本港共錄得61萬6200多人次出入境。
港台引述入境處數字，入境約33萬7500人次，出境約27萬8000多人次。入境人士中，內地訪客有17萬3000多人次，本港居民佔14萬6000多人次。整體最多人經落馬洲支線管制站入境，其次為羅湖。
出境以本港居民為主，有19萬4000多人次。離境人士主要經機場及落馬洲支線管制站。
入境處較早時表示，星期日上午十時前已錄得18萬4700多人次出入境。財政司司長陳茂波在網誌稱，黃金周首三日超過73萬2000內地旅客人次訪港，按年增加約百分之8.4；入境處預計整個黃金周約有129萬內地旅客訪港。
